summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a Form 6-K on June 17, 2026, reporting changes to its Board of Directors and executive structure. The registrant announced appointments at its ordinary general shareholders meeting, including Kenta Kon as President and Member of the Board of Directors, and Akio Toyoda as Chairman of the Board of Directors. Koji Sato stepped down as Vice Chairman but remains Chief Industry Officer. No financial terms, premiums, or stakeholder percentages were disclosed. This filing is a routine corporate governance update with no impact on capital structure or shareholder value. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K is the US equivalent of a material change report. No risk-arb angle applies.
